modules.name: Project Setup (Web)
modules.description: Web area for creating projects, buildings and flats, defining amenities per project and controlling admin staff access by project.

requirements.title: Create project, building, flat
requirements.description: The system must allow creating a project, building and flat. A saved new project becomes available for Society Manager assignment.

requirements.title: Amenities per project
requirements.description: The system must support amenities per project. When a hall is added and saved, residents of that project can book it.

rules.title: Admin staff access limited by project
rules.description: Admin staff can only see the projects they have been given access to. Staff given Project A only see Project A only after logging in.
